title: How sources define it

rows.unhcr: People outside their country who need international protection, counted under UNHCR's mandate at year end (from 1951).
rows.idmc: Not counted (IDMC covers people inside their own country).
rows.gov_india: No national refugee law. Figures for Sri Lankan refugees count camp residents and those registered outside camps, on one stated date.

rows.unhcr: Pending claims for international protection at year end (from 1993).
rows.gov_india: Not used in the figures on this site.

rows.unhcr: Conflict IDPs that UNHCR protects or assists ('of concern'), year end (from 1993). Disasters not included.
rows.idmc: All people displaced inside their country by conflict and violence (from 2009) or disasters (from 2008). Stock at year end plus new displacements during the year. Mostly estimates.
rows.gov_india: Not used in the figures on this site.

rows.term: Other people in need of international protection
rows.unhcr: People forced across a border who are not counted as refugees or asylum seekers (from 2018).
Not considered a national by any country under its law (from 2004). Can overlap with refugees.
rows.gov_india: Not used in the figures on this site.
Not stated in the figures used here.

rows.unhcr: Mostly year-end stocks; returns, resettlement and asylum claims are yearly flows.
rows.idmc: Year-end stock and yearly new displacements (movements, not people).
rows.gov_india: A count on one stated date.

notes: UNHCR and IDMC IDP figures overlap, so they are shown side by side and never added.
The IDP definition (UN Guiding Principles on Internal Displacement, 1998) sets no minimum distance.
